entities.name: 2010 Filair Let L-410 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 25 August 2010, a Let L-410 Turbolet passenger aircraft of Filair crashed on approach to Bandundu Airport in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing all but one of the 21 people on board.
